Method of Attack: port 6379 scans to find exposed Redis instances
INFO command to receive information about the Redis server
SLAVEOF command to create a replica of the attacking server
REPLCONF command to configure a connection from the master to the replica
PSYNC command to initiate a replication stream
MODULE LOAD command to load a module from the dynamic library
SLAVEOF NO ONE command to disable replication and turn the vulnerable Redis server into a master
